title: JtT: Rethinking Point Trajectory Diffusion for Diverse and Rigid Motion from an Image
title_zh: JtT：从图像出发，重新思考点轨迹扩散模型在生成多样化且刚体运动的能力

paragraphs.en: 文章提出了一种名为JtT的扩散模型，能够仅从单张图像预测场景中任意点的多样化且物理合理的未来轨迹。 We study forecasting rigid-body motion from a single image: generating diverse and physically plausible future trajectories for arbitrary points in a scene, without building rigidity into the architecture or relying on geometric inputs such as depth. Like video generators, recent trajectory generators fail at this task, even in simple synthetic Kubric scenes, despite scaling up model size and training on real data. We show how to solve this with the right architecture and parameterization. Our model, JtT, is a simple diffusion transformer that operates directly in coordinate space and decodes arbitrary and dense query patterns, without the trajectory VAEs or fixed grids assumed in prior work. Through a systematic study of the design space of point trajectory diffusion, we find that diffusing per-frame velocities is the only parameterization that captures rigidity, that it must be paired with the right timestep schedule, and that adding full-resolution RGB at the query points resolves the boundary failures of prior methods. However, evaluating such 2D models rigorously is itself non-trivial. To our knowledge, we are the first to observe that physical plausibility and diversity do not improve together during training: larger models, as used in prior work, memorize the single ground-truth future per training image, becoming more rigid while covering fewer possible futures. Yet prior work has paid little attention to this, so we show how model rankings depend on model size, metric, and stopping time, and adopt a stricter, checkpoint-averaged evaluation protocol. Under this protocol, JtT improves over prior methods on both distributional and rigidity metrics and approaches ground-truth rigidity, with only about 50M parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为JtT的扩散模型，该模型能够仅从单张图像预测场景中任意点的多样化且物理合理的未来轨迹。我们研究了基于单张图像预测刚体运动的问题：为场景中任意点生成多样化且物理合理的未来轨迹，而无需在模型架构中内置刚性约束，也无需依赖深度等几何输入。 与视频生成模型类似，近期的轨迹生成模型在这一任务上表现不佳，即便是在简单的合成Kubric场景中也存在困难，尽管它们扩大了模型规模并使用了真实数据进行训练。 我们展示了如何通过合适的架构和参数化方法解决这一问题。 我们的模型JtT是一种简单的扩散Transformer，直接在坐标空间中进行操作，并能解码任意且密集的查询模式，无需依赖先前工作所假设的轨迹VAE或固定网格。 通过对点轨迹扩散设计空间的系统性研究，我们发现逐帧速度扩散是唯一能够捕捉刚性约束的参数化方法；该方法必须搭配合适的步长调度方案，并且在查询点处加入全分辨率的RGB信息，才能解决先前方法的边界失效问题。 然而，对这类2D模型进行严格评估本身并非易事。 据我们所知，我们是首个观察到物理合理性与多样性在训练过程中无法同步提升的研究团队：先前工作所使用的大规模模型会记住每张训练图像对应的单一真实未来轨迹，导致模型刚性增强，但能覆盖的可能未来却更少。 尽管如此，先前工作对此问题关注甚少，因此我们展示了模型排名如何受模型规模、评估指标和终止时间的影响，并采用了一种更严格的基于检查点平均的评估协议。 在该协议下，JtT在分布性和刚性评估指标上均优于先前方法，并且接近真实刚性水平，而参数量仅为约50M。
